response.title: Python script to pull Shopify orders into Google Sheets daily
response.description:
Python script to pull Shopify orders into Google Sheets daily

Budget $250 – $750 USD
Paid on delivery

Project details
I need a Python script that runs once a day, pulls the previous day's orders from my Shopify store through the API, and adds them to a Google Sheet: order number, date, customer email, items, total and fulfilment status. It should skip orders that are already in the sheet and write a short log so I can see it ran.

Please explain how you would schedule it and how you would handle Shopify API rate limits.

Skills Required
Python · Shopify · Google Sheets · API

About the client
Payment verified
explicit_requirements: pull the previous day's orders from my Shopify store through the API
add them to a Google Sheet: order number, date, customer email, items, total and fulfilment status
skip orders that are already in the sheet
write a short log so I can see it ran
explain how you would schedule it and how you would handle Shopify API rate limits
